name: openai_api_key_recognizer
note: OpenAI API key: sk- (optionally sk-proj-/sk-svcacct-…), then 20 alphanumerics, the 'T3BlbkFJ' marker (base64 of 'OpenAI'), 20 more. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/openai.py; leading \b added and the original's [A-Za-z0-9-_] class (accidentally containing the range 9-_) corrected to [A-Za-z0-9_-].
